blocks.text: Cricket update: Runs and records galore as Sunrisers beat Spirit in men's Hundred. Sunrisers Leeds post the biggest score in Hundred history, making 241, on a night when numerous records were broken as the home side beat London Spirit by 37 runs at Headingley.
